description: Information an AI feature keeps outside the model and loads back into the context: within a conversation or across sessions.
What gets stored, when, and in which form: extraction, filters, deduplication and conflict handling.
What gets loaded for a call: scoring by relevance, recency and importance, top-k and a token budget.
A graph of facts that carry validity time, so changes are explicit and past states can be queried.
Injected content that is stored and steers future sessions.
This module's checkpoint: the memory design for a product briefing, checked for structure and coherence.
